_about: Providers in order of preference; enabled=false ones are skipped (the free tiers are phased out since 2026-10-12; anthropic is kept for if API access is ever available). trains: whether the provider may train on / log prompts (true, false, unknown); only trains=false providers receive data marked private. local: a server on this machine (nothing leaves it). source: the resolution source recorded for answers from this provider (local-llm, haiku, freellm). Keys come from the named env var (or ~/.config/gbl-synapse/env, ~/.config/freellm/env); keyless providers have key_env null. base_env/model_env: env vars overriding the endpoint/model. fallback: models tried when the configured one isn't installed. repeatable: may give several independent answers (--agree). seeded: a different seed per answer. structured: supports response_format json_schema. price_per_mtok: USD per million tokens, for the usage log. Optional body / body_text / body_vision: extra request fields.

providers.name: ollama
providers.limits: Local Ollama server on this Mac: no quota, no cost, nothing leaves the machine. One request at a time on the GPU.
providers.note: 2026-10-12: qwen2.5vl:7b failed every Validate gate except nameplate reading (not needed) and was deleted; qwen3-vl:32b is pulled and gated by after-harvest.sh.

providers.name: anthropic
providers.limits: Disabled: kept for if API access is ever available (the owner has a Claude subscription, not API billing). Needs `pip install anthropic`. Anthropic doesn't train on API inputs by default. Prices: Claude Haiku 5.5 for prompts up to 100K tokens ($0.50/$2.50 per MTok beyond).

providers.name: groq
providers.limits: Phased out 2026-10-12. 30 RPM, 1,000 RPD; qwen vision: 8,000 tokens/min and 200,000 tokens/day

providers.name: gemini
providers.limits: Phased out 2026-10-12. 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD (free-tier prompts may be used by Google outside the EEA/UK/CH)

providers.name: mistral
providers.limits: Phased out 2026-10-12. ~1 RPS; trains unless you opt out in the console

providers.name: openrouter-nolog

providers.name: openrouter
